name: X-ray repair cross complementing 4

function.text: XRCC4 encodes DNA repair protein XRCC4 [Cleaved into: Protein XRCC4, C-terminus]. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and FHA domain binding. It participates in positive regulation of ligase activity and base-excision repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to short stature, microcephaly, and endocrine dysfunction (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
